reference_implementation.rule: the campaign refuses to score (REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED) if any reference file sha256 differs from sha256_at_registration, or if the numpy version differs from 2.4.4; a changed reference requires a new contract version

numpy_rng_sources.statement: the stream semantics are numpy v2.4.4's (registered reference environment): numpy/random/bit_generator.pyx (SeedSequence: _coerce_to_uint32_array, hashmix, mix, mix_entropy, generate_state), numpy/random/_pcg64.pyx and src/pcg64/pcg64.{h,c} (pcg64_set_seed = pcg_setseq_128_srandom_r, XSL-RR 128/64 output, next_double = (next_uint64 >> 11) * 2^-53), src/distributions/distributions.c (random_standard_normal 256-layer ziggurat, random_standard_normal_fill), src/distributions/ziggurat_constants.h (ki_double, wi_double, fi_double, ziggurat_nor_r, ziggurat_nor_inv_r), numpy/lib/_function_base_impl.py (_quantile / _get_indexes / _get_gamma / _lerp, method 'linear')
numpy_rng_sources.sdist: numpy-2.4.4.tar.gz sha256 2d390634c5182175533585cc89f3608a4682ccb173cc9bb940b2881c8d6f8fa0 (the ziggurat tables are copied verbatim from it into crates/abep-rng/src/ziggurat.rs)

randomized_domain.count: per master seed: 300 abep-rng streams (seed uniform in [0, 2^31 - 2] for 200 of them and in [0, 2^128) for 100; per stream: SeedSequence pool, generate_state(8, uint32), generate_state(4, uint64), the PCG64 state after seeding, 64 next_uint64, 64 random(), and standard_normal(size) with size uniform in [1, 20000]); 200 stable_seed part lists (1-4 parts of printable ASCII and non-ASCII text); every stable seed the study uses ('tpmc', candidate, scenario for the 48 x 10 pairs) with standard_normal(n x 197 x 3 x 3) for n = 100; 300 np_percentile vectors (length 1-400, q from {5, 50, 95} and uniform in [0, 100], values with ties); 2000 perturbed vectors (random record, area, SE and z including large negative z to hit the 1e-30 floor); 40 tpmc_monte_carlo vectors (random survivor subset of size 1-6 from the study survivors of the respective implementation's sub-grid, random scenario subset, n uniform in [1, 40], both walls); 40 state_eval vectors; 30 plant_with_overrides vectors (random FIXED coefficient, factor in [0.5, 1.5])
randomized_domain.draw: numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([master_seed, entry_index])) per entry; written to the scratch work directory and fed to both implementations
randomized_domain.domain_note: numerical parity domain only; not a physics, design or evidence claim

inputs.fixed_input_entries_rule: entries without a seed are the same vector in development and scoring; a development execution of them is recorded as development in campaign_history and never reported as a verdict

rng_stream_roles.rule: A9.29 sec. 7 (RM-OQ-03): design / UQ sampling uses exact registered stream parity; TPMC particle tracing uses the existing admitted stochastic / statistical parity contract; the roles are registered separately and never merged
rng_stream_roles.design_uq_sampling_stream: EXACT_STREAM - the registered numpy PCG64 / SeedSequence / Generator stream semantics (abep-rng) reproducing the Python reference samples of the active F8 sampling: tpmc_monte_carlo's z = default_rng(stable_seed('tpmc', candidate, scenario)).standard_normal((n, n_states, 3, 3)) (C order); every raw word and every normal draw bit-identical
rng_stream_roles.tpmc_particle_tracing_stream: NOT_APPLICABLE in this contract: tpmc_monte_carlo traces no particle (it perturbs the committed F1 records by their binomial / replicate SEs; tpmc_backend_policy: tpmc_invoked_by_f7_f8 = false). Any future TPMC re-evaluation keeps the admitted Kernel-1 STATISTICAL contract (docs/performance/abep_core/parity_prereg_v2.json / parity_report_v2.json, Rust xoshiro256++) and is never re-registered on this stream
rng_stream_roles.other_streams: the harness vector generator only (numpy default_rng from the registered master seeds; it produces inputs, never a scored quantity)
rng_stream_roles.migration_parity_dataset: seeds, stream semantics and captured reference samples of the migration parity campaign stay exactly reproducible (immutable)
rng_stream_roles.after_rust_authority: new UQ campaigns may use the registered Rust RNG policy; this never changes the migration parity dataset

campaign_seeds.rng_streams_v3: identical streams (EXACT_STREAM: numpy PCG64 + Generator ported in abep-rng)
campaign_seeds.development_rule: development comparisons use development_master_seed and the development sub-grid only and are never scored or reported as a verdict; every execution with scoring_master_seed is appended to campaign_history and the report is committed whatever its verdict

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, statuses, error codes, schema shape: equal
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= 4 ulp(py) OR <= 1e-9 * max(1, |py|); NaN only where the reference is NaN
tolerance_classes.STATISTICAL: NOT_APPLICABLE (no statistical entry: the F8 sampling stream is EXACT_STREAM)
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: RNG streams identical by construction (ported bit generator and distribution algorithm); every word and draw bit-identical; derived quantities then ULP_BOUNDED / EXACT_VALUE as listed; A9.29 sec. 7: the design / UQ sampling stream only, never the TPMC particle-tracing kernel

exact_invariants.statement: the evidence-gate snapshot is unchanged by the robust filter (gates before == after) in both implementations

a candidate enters the robust Pareto filter only if it is nominally feasible in EVERY admitted scenario (fail closed); the robust set may be EMPTY and an empty set is reported as such (count 0), never replaced by a relaxed subset
MC draws do not depend on batching: the z stream of a (candidate, scenario) is identical whether it is drawn in the study or alone
the carried robust set never yields a representative (RepresentativeSelectionRefused -> NOT_EVALUATED)
probabilities (P_feasible) are reported only per scenario-set member over the quantified TPMC statistics; no weight is attached to a scenario
determinism: two Rust executions of the study give bit-identical outputs

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable meets its tolerance class (proximity differences recorded as NOT_SCORED_AT_THRESHOLD)
decision_rules.proximity_limit: if more than 1 % of the scored discrete outcomes of an entry are NOT_SCORED_AT_THRESHOLD the entry fails
decision_rules.exact_stream_rule: any differing raw word or draw of a registered stream fails the contract (no proximity rule applies to EXACT_STREAM)
decision_rules.scoring_once: the scoring comparison runs once (scoring_master_seed); the harness refuses a second scoring run when parity_report_v1.json exists
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every per-test, stream, invariant, domain/error and schema check passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; PARITY_PASS <=> ADMITTED
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for the registered functions and for the registered numpy stream semantics of the design / UQ sampling stream. It is NOT physics validation.
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: restricted to the active F8 robust optimisation / UQ; no observable depends on uq6 / uq_modular / mission_uq / uncertainty (RM-R20)

not a gate PASS; an EMPTY robust set is a result, not a failure of the software, and is never 'fixed' by retuning (A9.31 secs. 12, 21)
